As the books are all published, we operate under the assumption that all spoilers are valid. Readers come here at their own risk! There are many other discussion groups that are more spoiler-friendly, but our aim at the Wheel of Time wiki is as a reference resource for those who have read the series or who don't mind spoilers.

If you see any pages with spoiler warnings on them, please remove this template from the page.
